# RoleNestra
> RoleNestra (rolenestra.com) is an honest career-document studio operated by Apex Grid Engineering PLLC. It tailors resumes, role-specific cover letters, and interview-preparation material to a target job posting using ONLY the customer's real, attested work record.

## What RoleNestra does
- Resume Refresh ($19/order): one tailored resume for one posting, traceability check, role-alignment checklist, one consolidated revision round, editable text export.
- Application Kit ($39/order): Resume Refresh plus one cover letter built only from the customer's record.
- Interview Ready ($79/order): Application Kit plus interview question practice and achievement-story prompts drawn only from the approved record.
- Repeat pricing within 90 days: Application Kit $29, Interview Ready $59. Search Season Pack: 3 Application Kits for $99 across three postings within 6 months. No subscriptions; nothing auto-renews.

## The Honesty Law (the company's defining rule)
- RoleNestra NEVER fabricates or inflates experience, employers, titles, dates, education, credentials, certifications, skills, metrics, or outcomes — including at the customer's request.
- Keywords from a posting are used only where the customer's record supports the underlying fact. Unsupported requirements are flagged to the customer in a role-alignment checklist, never silently inserted.
- Every substantive claim in a delivered draft must trace to the customer's source record.
- NO outcome is guaranteed: no promised interviews, callbacks, ATS passage or scores, offers, or employment. No predicted match scores are published.

## Consumer data
- Working source files are deleted 30 days after delivery. Consented structured-record retention lasts until customer deletion or 12 months of inactivity. Deletion on request completes within 7 days.
- Contact: info@rolenestra.com
